sn36.2:1.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || || Imā kho bhikkhave tisso vedanā ti || ||
sn36.2:2.1: Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ || adukkhamasukhaṃ saha || Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca || Yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ || ||
sn36.2:3.1: Etaṃ dukkhan ti ñatvāna || mosadhammam palokinaṃ || Phussaphussavayam passaṃ || evaṃ tattha virajjatīti || || Tisso
